category_edits.rationale: Apply the supplied hypothesis across all four datasets: couple smaller Adam updates with stronger input dropout. Preserve the GRU architecture, loss, readout, seeds and training limits. The predictor disables dropout during inference, so no predictor changes are required. Prior evidence records a regression for this configuration; this edit implements the requested experiment without claiming improvement.

change_summary: Set shared dropout to 0.15 and Adam learning rate to 0.0007, retaining one independent GRU4Rec checkpoint per category.
